title: Severe latency on Postgres session store under peak load
comments: After profiling connection exhaustion on Postgres under peak user load, Alice Vance decided: Migrate session storage from Postgres to Redis cluster to eliminate database connection pool contention. System: Redis.

title: Redis session cluster operational maintenance and failover complexity
comments: Given recurring operational failover complexity of standalone Redis clusters, Alice Vance decided: Migrate session storage to embedded Keycloak cache. This decision supersedes Migrate session storage from Postgres to Redis cluster. System: Keycloak.

title: Slow analytical queries on historical clickstream datasets
comments: After evaluating data warehouse capacity for ad-hoc aggregations, Fiona Gallagher decided: Adopt Snowflake for analytics ETL queries to decouple reporting compute from transactional systems. System: Snowflake.

title: High compute credits on daily analytics warehouse rollups
comments: Due to soaring cloud warehouse compute costs and 10x slower p95 reporting queries, Carlos Mendez decided: Migrate analytics reporting queries from Snowflake to ClickHouse cluster. This decision supersedes Adopt Snowflake for analytics ETL queries. System: ClickHouse.

title: Need enterprise event bus for asynchronous order processing
comments: To guarantee strictly-ordered replayable message streams across our microservices, Alice Vance decided: Use Kafka for all event messaging across services. System: Kafka.

title: Lightweight pubsub requirements for async background tasks
comments: To avoid heavy JVM JVM operational overhead and complex partition management for simple workers, Bob Martin decided: Use RabbitMQ for all event messaging across services. This decision contradicts Use Kafka for all event messaging across services. System: Kafka.

title: Plaintext secret leakage risk in CI/CD pipeline variables
comments: Following an internal audit of credentials stored in build configurations, Diana Prince decided: Store secret credentials exclusively in HashiCorp Vault instead of Kubernetes secrets. System: Vault.

title: Inconsistent distributed trace propagation in checkout services
comments: To enable end-to-end distributed transaction tracing with minimal agent configuration, Kevin Flynn decided: Standardize application traces on Datadog APM across all production services. System: Datadog.

title: Cluster-wide metrics collection and automated alerts
comments: To achieve standardized Kubernetes metrics collection and alerting, Laura Croft decided: Deploy Prometheus Operator on all Kubernetes staging clusters. System: Prometheus.

title: Memory pressure on legacy RabbitMQ broker during notifications spike
comments: After profiling message broker RAM usage during customer broadcast spikes, Ian Malcolm decided: Deprecate legacy RabbitMQ clusters in favor of native Redis PubSub for low-volume notifications. System: Redis.

title: OAuth2 token issuance architecture for internal gateway
comments: To streamline microservice token validation and role-based access control, Julia Roberts decided: Use Keycloak OAuth2 tokens for internal API gateway authentication. System: Keycloak.

title: Replication lag and connection pool contention on primary database
comments: To leverage native logical replication performance and query pipeline improvements, Evan Wright decided: Upgrade all production Postgres instances to version 16. System: Postgres.
